description: Create a new API key for programmatic access to a specific bot. Store the key securely as it cannot be retrieved later.

botId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the bot to create the API key for

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the key should expire (e.g., '2026-12-31T23:59:59Z'). Key never expires if omitted.

name.description: Descriptive name for the API key to identify its purpose (e.g., 'Production CRM Integration')

name: neuron_create_api_key
title: Create API Key
